name: @usdk/capability-voice
description: The capability-voice interface contract: microphone -> transcription and approved-text -> speech synthesis, as a replaceable pipeline (PDF Hypothesis III, page 4, 'Voice Interface'). Contains no implementation - see @usdk/driver-voice for the Web Speech API-backed browser driver, and its README for exactly which stages are local vs. a browser/cloud service (do not assume offline - see docs/UAGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md).
